scope: Finite Fourier endpoint polynomials for exact Hermite assembly over one fixed infinite metric. R6 bounds on these polynomials are checked separately using exact arithmetic. These packets do not certify continuous-flow endpoint errors, infinite nonlinear continuation, or common-exterior C2 Cauchy convergence.
gauge: Centered planar primitive; at each selected port the nonradial mean height is chosen zero. Exterior height must be shifted to this port gauge before assembly, and inter-depth gauge differences must be controlled.
